raw:
“My first crop of strawberries on the balcony—that made me happy. I had six ripe berries, all in one bowl. Six doesn’t sound like a lot, but when they’re your own strawberries, it feels different. I kept looking at that bowl and thinking, I grew those.

“I saved two for a neighbor. That was part of the pleasure, having enough to share, even with such a little crop. A bowl of strawberries makes you think of eating them, and then of who else might enjoy them. But the thing I remember most is that they were my first ones. Just six berries, and I was so pleased.”
